name: interval bound only counts work that depends on the window's opening link
description: h1 -> h2 run on the CPU (2 each) while s (3, GPU) runs in parallel from the input; out (1) waits for both, so the optimum is 5. s does not depend on h1, so it must not be charged to the window [t(h1), t(h2)]: doing so would claim 2 + 3 + 1 = 6.
